description: This server builds outside cedar-parent and declares its own versions, so Renovate watches them here, on main, under the shared CEDAR backend policy.

packageRules.description: The released artifact library is an ordinary dependency here, not a train-controlled version. CEDAR releases are in the BMIR Nexus releases repository, which the shared policy's proxy does not serve.
This server matches jackson-databind to what the artifact library brings, so databind moves with the library.
Keep the Maven build plugins in one maintenance pull request, as cedar-parent does.
